rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for honouring the memory of a person or event with a ceremony, object, or other act.

example.english: We hold an event every year to commemorate the people who died in that fire.
example.traditional: 我哋每年都會舉行活動紀念嗰場大火入面犧牲嘅人。
